title: kate-core: compare the file on disk with the last read
summary: Command::CheckDisk reads the bytes at the document path and calls FileState::note_disk, so disk_change says Modified, Deleted, or Created. The buffer does not change. A document without a path does nothing. The file watcher in the window sends this command.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. workspace.rs is a 3,500-line file and the change touches its command dispatch. The Linux VM builds and tests kate-core. The owner Mac stays free for the window.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add the CheckDisk variant after Reload in command.rs. In workspace.rs add the arm Command::CheckDisk => check_disk_cmd(ws, view) to run_file. check_disk_cmd takes the document path from doc.file; None returns Ok(()). It calls kate_fileio::load(&path, &ws.decode_options()). Ok(loaded) calls file.note_disk(true, loaded.digest). Err(LoadError::Io(e)) with e.kind() NotFound calls file.note_disk(false, file.digest_on_disk). Any other error returns CommandError::Load. The buffer, the history, and the selections stay unchanged. The test check_disk_marks_a_changed_file writes a temp file with a, opens it, appends b on disk, executes CheckDisk, and asserts disk_change is Some(DiskChange::Modified). It then removes the file, executes CheckDisk, and asserts Some(DiskChange::Deleted). It uses tempfile::tempdir. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::check_disk_marks_a_changed_file
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because Command::CheckDisk does not exist. After the change a changed file is Modified and a removed file is Deleted.
